snippet.title: Launch Date Announcement Gameplay Trailer | Revenge of the Savage Planet Official | IGN Fan Fest
snippet.description:
It’s Tool Time at Kindred Labs with former CEO of 4th Best Kindred Aerospace, Martin Tweed, from the critically acclaimed Xbox Game Pass and Playstation Plus title, Journey to the Savage Planet.  Enjoy a free-to-watch gameplay preview featuring some of the new abilities available to you AND A FRIEND in the upcoming sequel launch of Revenge of the Savage Planet.  Strap-in and blast-off on May 8th with the Super Simple Edition or break the bank and purchase the Cosmic Hoarder Edition for an early access period beginning May 5th.  

Click or tap that Wishlist Button because if you purchase Revenge of the Savage Planet within the first month of launch you’ll receive the Cinco De Mayo Trash Panda Suit.

Xbox: Join us for the colonization of space Day One with Xbox Game Pass.  Visit the Xbox Store to view the launch bonus programs and Cosmic Hoarder Edition upgrade option. 
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/revenge-of-the-savage-planet/9pftv8dknchx 

Steam: Purchase within the first month of launch and receive a bonus copy of Journey to the Savage Planet.  Additionally, purchase the first week on Steam and you’ll also receive a 10% discount.  Don’t miss out, wishlist today so you can be notified of the release and to secure your spot in space!  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787320/Revenge_of_the_Savage_Planet/ 

Playstation: Browse the robust selection of bonus goods in the Cosmic Hoarder Edition and don't forget about that Cinco de Mayo Trash Panda Suit.
https://store.playstation.com/en-ca/concept/10009791/ 

Follow @SavagePlanetHub on social for more information and content.

Check out the additional ways to book a trip to space - https://www.savageplanet.games/en-US/play
